# TikTok

> TikTok is a short-form video platform owned by ByteDance, offering creator tools, business advertising solutions, and comprehensive safety policies.

The platform provides TikTok for Business advertising products including In-Feed Ads, TopView, and TikTok Shop, alongside robust content moderation, community guidelines, and safety resources to protect users from harmful content including CSAM and deepfakes.

## Key Topics

- TikTok for Business
- In-Feed Ads
- TopView
- TikTok Ads Manager
- Creator Marketplace
- TikTok Shop
- Community Guidelines
- Content moderation
- Brand awareness campaigns
- Brand safety
- Child protection (CSAM)
- Sexual abuse reporting
- Privacy and cookies
- AI and deepfakes
- Creative Center

## Business Advertising Case Studies

- [TikTok Advertising Blog: Find Product Updates, Insights & Tips](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en/blog): TikTok for Business blog with advertising updates and marketing guides
- [Yves Saint Laurent | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/yves-saint-laurent-221): YSL Black Opium perfume Christmas campaign case study with influencers
- [HP | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/hp-311): HP Spectre x360 brand lift and brand safety campaign with DoubleVerify
- [Momentary Ink | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en/inspiration/momentary-ink-161): Momentary Ink temporary tattoos summer sales campaign using TikTok Ads
- [Monnalisa | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/monnalisa-344): Monnalisa brand awareness campaign targeting new generation in Italy
- [Madwell | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/madewell-358): Madewell denim jeans audience targeting with In-Feed Ads campaign
- [Curiously Cinnamon | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/curiously-cinnamon-232): Nestle Curiously Cinnamon cereal brand awareness TopView campaign
- [BukuWarung | TikTok for Business Case Study](https://www.tiktok.com/business/en-SG/inspiration/bukuwarung-409): BukuWarung Indonesian fintech user acquisition via App Event Optimization

## Safety and Well-Being Resources

- [Sexual abuse](https://www.tiktok.com/safety/resources/sexual-assault-resources): Sexual abuse policy, reporting tools, and professional support resources
- [Well-being guide](https://www.tiktok.com/safety/en/well-being-guide): Digital well-being toolkit for mental health and healthy online habits
